interaction.prompt: You have the puck up high in the zone. One teammate has open ice; the other is covered by a defender. Tap the teammate with the most time and space.

feedback.right: Your LW has clean ice — no opponent nearby. That means time to catch, turn, and make the next play without pressure.
feedback.wrong: A defender is right on your RW. Passing there means your teammate has no time and no space — the puck gets tied up or picked off immediately.

tip: Before you pass, find the player with no defender close by. That open gap is exactly what 'time and space' looks like on ice.
why: Time and space is the anchor for every on-ice read. A covered teammate has neither — always find the player with open ice first.
